comments_text: Discovery: deletion from the genome followed by recombinant expression and chemical synthesis (85.9% pure) to verify activity. Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (38.71%) to ABP-118 G: 30%, A: 15%. GRAVY: 0.33; mol Wt: 5139.859; mol formula: C230H355N67O63S2; mol ex coeff: 23815. Activity: Knock out lost activity against E. faecalis VA797, E. faecium H3, L. helveticus B1942, S. mutans GS-5, S. mutans UA159, and S. salivarius K-12. Inhibition zone (50 ul of 100 ug/ml): synthetic peptide inhibited S. thermophilus ST113, P. acidilactici, L. inoccua, and S. mutans. Recombinant production:bacteria:Escherichia coli: expressed as GST-BlpU fusion protein, which was cleaved with Factor Xa protease. Est. 7/2024
title: BlpU is a broad-spectrum bacteriocin in Streptococcus thermophilus
